# `/certifications` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /certifications/v1/{id}/decision-summary

`getIdentityDecisionSummaryV1` — Summary of certification decisions

This API returns a summary of the decisions made on an identity campaign certification. The decisions are summarized by type. Reviewers for this certification can also call this API.

- Scopes: idn:campaign:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, CERT_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The certification ID
  - `filters` (query) — fields: identitySummary.id: eq, in — e.g. `identitySummary.id eq "ef38f94347e94562b5bb8424a56397d8"`
- Returns 200: identitycertdecisionsummary

### GET /certifications/v1/{id}/identity-summaries

`getIdentitySummariesV1` — Identity summaries for campaign certification

This API returns a list of the identity summaries for a specific identity campaign certification. Reviewers for this certification can also call this API.

- Scopes: idn:campaign:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, CERT_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The identity campaign certification ID
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
  - `count` (query) — default False — If *true* it will populate the *X-Total-Count* response header with the number of results that would be returned if *limit* and *offset* were ignored. Since requesting a total count can have a…
  - `filters` (query) — fields: id: eq, in; completed: eq, ne; name: eq, sw — e.g. `id eq "ef38f94347e94562b5bb8424a56397d8"`
  - `sorters` (query) — fields: name — e.g. `name`
- Returns 200: array of certificationidentitysummary

### GET /certifications/v1/{id}/access-summaries/{type}

`getIdentityAccessSummariesV1` — Access summaries

This API returns a list of access summaries for the specified identity campaign certification and type. Reviewers for this certification can also call this API.

- Scopes: idn:campaign:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, CERT_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The identity campaign certification ID
  - `type` (path, required) — one of ROLE, ACCESS_PROFILE, ENTITLEMENT — The type of access review item to retrieve summaries for
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
  - `count` (query) — default False — If *true* it will populate the *X-Total-Count* response header with the number of results that would be returned if *limit* and *offset* were ignored. Since requesting a total count can have a…
  - `filters` (query) — fields: completed: eq, ne; access.id: eq, in; access.name: eq, sw; entitlement.sourceName: eq, sw; accessProfile.sourceName: eq, sw — e.g. `access.id eq "ef38f94347e94562b5bb8424a56397d8"`
  - `sorters` (query) — fields: access.name — e.g. `access.name`
- Returns 200: array of accesssummary

### GET /certifications/v1/{id}/identity-summaries/{identitySummaryId}

`getIdentitySummaryV1` — Summary for identity

This API returns the summary for an identity on a specified identity campaign certification. Reviewers for this certification can also call this API.

- Scopes: idn:campaign:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, CERT_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The identity campaign certification ID
  - `identitySummaryId` (path, required) — The identity summary ID
- Returns 200: certificationidentitysummary

### GET /certifications/v1

`listIdentityCertificationsV1` — List identity campaign certifications

Use this API to get a list of identity campaign certifications for the specified query parameters. Any authenticated token can call this API, but only certifications you are authorized to review will be returned. This API does not support requests for certifications assigned to governance groups.

- Scopes: idn:campaign:read
- Parameters:
  - `reviewer-identity` (query) — Reviewer's identity. *me* indicates the current user.
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
  - `count` (query) — default False — If *true* it will populate the *X-Total-Count* response header with the number of results that would be returned if *limit* and *offset* were ignored. Since requesting a total count can have a…
  - `filters` (query) — fields: id: eq, in; campaign.id: eq, in; phase: eq; completed: eq — e.g. `id eq "ef38f94347e94562b5bb8424a56397d8"`
  - `sorters` (query) — fields: name, due, signed — e.g. `name,due`
- Returns 200: array of identitycertificationdto

### GET /certifications/v1/{id}

`getIdentityCertificationV1` — Identity certification by id

This API returns a single identity campaign certification by its ID. Reviewers for this certification can also call this API.

- Scopes: idn:campaign:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, CERT_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The certification id
- Returns 200: identitycertificationdto

### POST /certifications/v1/{id}/decide

`makeIdentityDecisionV1` — Decide on a certification item

The API makes a decision to approve or revoke one or more identity campaign certification items. Reviewers for this certification can also call this API. This API does not support requests for certifications assigned to Governance Groups.

- Scopes: idn:campaign:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, CERT_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The ID of the identity campaign certification on which to make decisions
- Body (application/json): array of reviewdecision
- Returns 200: identitycertificationdto

### POST /certifications/v1/{id}/reassign

`reassignIdentityCertificationsV1` — Reassign identities or items

This API reassigns up to 50 identities or items in an identity campaign certification to another reviewer. A token with ORG_ADMIN or CERT_ADMIN authority is required to call this API. Reviewers for this certification can also call this API. This API does not support requests for certifications assigned to Governance Groups.

- Scopes: idn:campaign:manage
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The identity campaign certification ID
- Body (application/json): reviewreassign
- Returns 200: identitycertificationdto

### POST /certifications/v1/{id}/sign-off

`signOffIdentityCertificationV1` — Finalize identity certification decisions

This API finalizes all decisions made on an identity campaign certification and initiates any remediations required. Reviewers for this certification can also call this API. This API does not support requests for certifications assigned to Governance Groups.

- Scopes: idn:campaign:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, CERT_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The identity campaign certification ID
- Returns 200: identitycertificationdto

### POST /certifications/v1/{id}/reassign-async

`submitReassignCertsAsyncV1` — Reassign certifications asynchronously

This API initiates a task to reassign up to 500 identities or items in an identity campaign certification to another reviewer. The `certification-tasks` API can be used to get an updated status on the task and determine when the reassignment is complete. Reviewers for this certification can also call this API.

- Scopes: idn:campaign:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, CERT_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The identity campaign certification ID
- Body (application/json): reviewreassign
- Returns 200: certificationtask
